race.comment: IMPETUOUSLY (8) boasts strong form at this distance having won four times from five starts. Was out of placings last time (30.12) at Sandown in a Special conditions H, finishing fourth and beaten 6 lengths. Expected to be in the finish. COMMANCHE JACK (6) is a promising type who notched his 18th career success when too good (22.88) at Horsham last time. Solid record here including five wins. Has performed well from this box with a win and two minor placings to his name from four starts. Deserves serious consideration again. BULA (1) flew the lids with a fast early split but ran over at the finish when a narrow sixth (17.13) over 300m at this track. Has won seven of seven starts from this draw. Worth another chance. SON OF ROSIE (2) form at this distance reads well.
